title: Steel Building Projects in Pakistan | Steel Mind Engineers
description: See real steel projects by Steel Mind Engineers: PEB crane sheds, dairy sheds, mezzanine floors and a steel bridge, with sizes, clients and locations.
h1: Our Projects: Steel Buildings and Structures Built Across Pakistan
quickAnswer: Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. has built six documented projects with full details here, from a 484 square foot exit structure to a 97,888 square foot crane and mezzanine shed. Each card opens a page with size, client and location.
alt: Finished steel crane shed built by Steel Mind Engineers in Pakistan.

faq.q: What is the largest project Steel Mind Engineers has built?
faq.a: The PEB crane and mezzanine shed for Haier at Raiwind covers 97,888 square feet.

faq.q: Can I visit a finished project?
faq.a: Call to ask. Visits depend on the client's permission.

blocks.text: A steel contractor is best judged by what it has built. Every project below lists the client, the place, the height, the width, the length and the covered area. The largest crane sheds cover almost 100,000 square feet, and the dairy sheds show repeat work for the same farms.

bullets: Scale. Crane sheds of almost 100,000 square feet.
Range. Sheds, mezzanine floors and a steel bridge.
Repeat clients. Haier and Dravton Dairy came back for more than one structure.
Reach. Projects in Lahore, Kasur, Chunian and Sindh.

blocks.text: Send the use, size and location of your building. An engineer will review it and reply.
